phases.name: Pure governance/recovery decision logic (no sibling-track dependencies)

steps.name: Guardrail Evaluator: fail-closed governance-hold decision
steps.criteria: Returns GOVERNANCE_HOLD with an explicit reason when changedFilePaths is absent, never PENDING; returns PENDING when every changed path matches an allowlist pattern; returns GOVERNANCE_HOLD when at least one changed path is uncovered by the allowlist; decision is a pure function of its two inputs with no I/O
steps.scenario_name: the guardrail evaluator itself holds every completion for governance review while file-change data is unavailable; the guardrail evaluator clears every path covered by the allowlist

steps.name: Failure/Recovery Advisor: non-blaming guidance composition
steps.criteria: Message always contains whatCompleted, whatFailed, and rawOutputUrl together, never a bare link, for FAILED or HALTED; suggestedNextStep is RETRY and retryAvailable is true below MAX_AUTO_RETRY_COUNT; suggestedNextStep becomes ESCALATE and retryAvailable becomes false at or above the threshold, regardless of failure reason; decision is a pure function with no I/O
steps.scenario_name: Devon sees a clear, non-blaming summary within 2 minutes of a failed run; raw stack traces are never shown without plain-language context, for any failure; repeated failures always escalate instead of looping forever, regardless of failure reason

phases.name: Governance-gated HTTP configuration routes (own-scope tables only)

steps.name: Trello Ingestion Config routes with real governance-team access control
steps.criteria: POST /api/trello-ingestion/boards registers a board (boardId, defaultSubmitterHumanId, optional triggerListIds) into trello_ingestion_boards and returns 201; GET /api/trello-ingestion/boards lists boards including lastPolledAt, lastPollStatus, lastPollError; PATCH /api/trello-ingestion/boards/:boardId updates or enables/disables an existing board config; all three routes return 403 before any write when canManageTrelloIngestion(user) is false; canManageTrelloIngestion resolves governance-team membership via teams/team_memberships, mirroring canManageAgent
steps.scenario_name: a governance-team member registers a board for ingestion and can observe its poll status (regression check only, no new work: a submitter without any session cannot configure Trello ingestion boards)

steps.name: Guardrail Allowlist Config CRUD routes reusing governance-team access control
steps.criteria: POST /api/guardrail-allowlist creates a guardrail_allowlist_entries row from pathPattern and returns 201 with its id; GET /api/guardrail-allowlist lists every entry, including newly added patterns immediately; DELETE /api/guardrail-allowlist/:id removes an entry and returns 204; all three routes return 403 before any write when canManageTrelloIngestion(user) is false; reuses canManageTrelloIngestion per this file's existing deps type, not canSignOffGuardrail (that gates governance-signoff on nwave-runs, out of scope)
steps.scenario_name: a governance-team member manages the guardrail allowlist and sees new patterns reflected in governance decisions
